articles.title: Vincent Hobart, 65, Parish Bookkeeper
articles.deck: Friends remember Vincent Hobart for the many years of service to Hickory Ridge.
body: Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Kettle Hill Block Association in his or her name. Born in Hickory Ridge in the years after the war, Vincent Hobart spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Vincent Hobart died in May at home on Linden Street, at the age of 65. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Hickory Ridge.

articles.title: Then & Now: Millrace Green, 1972 and 2010
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1972 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Thistle Lane from the corner of Ingram Terrace. Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

Please keep the accessible ramp in the budget. Many of us on Rail Court use it every week. To the editor: I have lived on Rail Court for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group has made.
Lydia Feeney, Hickory Ridge

articles.deck: The program begins in October and is open to all students in grade 8 and up.
body: The board will review the results at the end of the spring term. Sign-up forms went home in backpacks this week, and the first session is set for October.
